description: This file defines the implementation of the OpenTelemetry SDK's Trace Provider, including configuration, creation, and management of tracers and span processors.

classes.name: tracerProviderConfig
classes.description: Configuration struct for setting up a TracerProvider, including processors, sampler, ID generator, span limits, and resource.

classes.name: TracerProvider
classes.description: Implements the OpenTelemetry TracerProvider interface, managing tracers, span processors, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: MarshalLog
methods.description: Serializes the tracerProviderConfig for logging purposes.

methods.name: NewTracerProvider
methods.description: Creates and configures a new TracerProvider with optional overrides.

methods.name: Tracer
methods.description: Returns a tracer with specified name and options, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: RegisterSpanProcessor
methods.description: Adds a span processor to the TracerProvider.

methods.name: UnregisterSpanProcessor
methods.description: Removes a span processor from the TracerProvider.

methods.name: ForceFlush
methods.description: Exports all spans that have not yet been exported.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the TracerProvider and all registered span processors, releasing resources.

methods.name: getSpanProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of span processors.
